periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Oblique orientation, angled downward toward the muzzle at approximately 45 degrees relative to the horizontal facial axis.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Vertical oval profile with a high height-to-width ratio.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced downward tapering, with the lower terminal point extending significantly below the geometric center of the patch.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Wide, shallow U-shaped curve profile at the superior junction of the dark band and white neck fur.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: High relative thickness, occupying the entirety of the visible lower frame below the neck.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide lateral separation, with the ears positioned on the extreme superior-lateral margins of the cranium.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: High smoothness with a consistent semicircular curvature at the apex.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant yellowish-brown chromic staining visible on the fur of the lower mandible and ventral neck region; visibility of upper incisors/canines.
other_distinctive_markers: Sharp color transition between the bright white cranial fur and the discolored tan-brown ventral neck fur.
